turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How may I help you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hi, yes it's nice to meet you. I've been having this cough that's been going on for the last few days and I have had difficulty breathing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that. When did this start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh, so the cough started about 3 days ago. Yeah, the shortness of breath has come on since then.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, well let's focus on the shortness of breath first and then we'll talk about your cough as well. So you noticed that you had difficulties with breathing sometime within the past three days. When do you find that it's difficult for you to breathe? Is there anything that makes breathing more difficult for you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, not really. Actually, it's been well, but just bad after I cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So say walking up the stairs or doing any exercise doesn't make it worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not really, I've been able to do the same amounts of of activity I guess.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so there's really no relationship with activity with your shortness of breath. OK, and I can see that you're able to sort of talk in full sentences.  OK, how is it making it difficult for you to do things at home, your difficulty breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I am a little bit, I mean, I feel I just haven't been feeling very good overall so I've been resting these last couple of days mostly.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and your cough, you said that started three days ago. Is it a dry cough or wet cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's dry. It's a dry cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and there's no sputum production with it? Anything coming up at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't noticed anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and is there anything that's making the cough better? Did you take anything? Any medications for it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I tried some over the counter stuff but it didn't help.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK alright. Other than the difficulty breathing and the cough, have you noticed any other symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've been really tired. I guess I've just sort of been  resting the these last few days and I've had a headache as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Can you tell me a bit more about your headache?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, it feels like somebody is just squeezing the top of or just squeezing the sides of my head.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had a headache like this before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I have, yeah. I usually get them when I'm dehydrated. Or maybe I haven't slept well. And that's also been the case for the past two to three days. Yeah, it's been kind of off and on, there are some times that are worse than others, but I've noticed that I had it for the most part for the last few days, OK,

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you taken anything for your headache? Any pain meds?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've been taking some Advil, it's helped.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And so you talked about being tired, having a headache, difficulties breathing, and coughing over the past three days. Have any of these symptoms gotten worse overtime?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, I would say, but both the cough and the shortness of breath has been getting worse over these last few days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any chills or have you checked your temperature?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I haven't checked my temperature, but I felt like I've had a fever or might be getting a fever.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: We can check your temperature here. And have you had any muscle aches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I guess I felt a bit achy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any redness in the eyes? Or any runny nose or sore throat like flu-like symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, I have, I don't know maybe my nose is a little bit congested, but not really running.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you had any change in your sense of smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't noticed that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What about your sense of taste? Are you able to taste things?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you noticed any rash anywhere on your body?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no,  I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any changes in your bowel movement, diarrhea or constipation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had any.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Alright, well it sounds like you have multiple symptoms right now that started about 3 days ago. You're feeling tired, you have a headache, difficulties breathing, some muscle aches and you've been feeling feverish. You've also had this cough, and your nose is feeling congested. Is there anything else that that you've been experiencing over the past three days that I haven't talked about yet?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, as you mentioned, the headache's there too, then yeah, that's everything.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, umm, alright, can you tell me about your past medical history? Do you have any medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I have asthma and GERD I think.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Umm, does the shortness of breath that you're experiencing feel similar to the asthma attacks in any way?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had any issues with like asthma attacks in a long time.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you have an inhaler?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I do but I don't use it very often.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, did you use it over the past three days at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah I did try it and it didn't really seem to help that much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uh, and other than that, have you had any any surgeries in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, I had a colonoscopy two years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any reason for that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhh, my father had colon cancer when he was in his 60s.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see OK, and any hospitalizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Do you take any medications? I know you have puffers. Any medications, including over the counter pills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I'll take like a Zantac or like Tums sometimes for reflux.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And, uh, any allergies to food, medications, or environmental allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I have environmental allergies. I think like usually they come on in the springtime.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: In terms of family histories, you did mention that your dad had colon cancer. Any other medical problems that that run in your family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you currently smoke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't and have never smoked in the past.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, what about marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you or have you ever had alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I will have some wine on the weekends, maybe a glass or two with dinner.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, sounds good and have you ever had any street drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Like a long time ago, maybe when I was in college, once or twice.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, sounds good, and have you had any contact with any sick people? Anyone who's sick recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not that I know of. I mean, I went to a few stores here and there that I had been going to. I've been working from home so maybe at one of the stores. And I would imagine I were wearing a mask and of course trying to maintain social distancing as much as possible. But yeah, you never, really know.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What about any other travels or any travels at all outside the city or the country recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no, I had been at home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright. So I guess that's all I wanted to know. I'll go talk to the attending and we'll come back and do a physical exam and maybe ask a couple more questions and then discuss the management with you. Does that sound good to you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, that sounds great.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Thank you. OK alright.
